headline: Quotienting each Pass-7164 E8 Coxeter C6 fiber by C3 gives 80 alternating root triples in a 240->80->40 tower. Their exact inner-product relations have valencies 1,24,54 and project respectively to antipode, W33 adjacency, and W33 nonadjacency. This is gauge-isomorphic to the fused antipodal orthogonality cover of the 80 nonzero two-qutrit Pauli vectors.
boundary: The fused 54-class is proved; an equivariant 27+27 symplectic-sign refinement remains open. Do not identify the internal E8 Coxeter C6 with the separate CZ-parity C6 without a future equivariant theorem.
